name: Original Iron Claymore Blade use restart

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=.2;local initial=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Blade use')
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4bb73));assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original Bandit Bowman missing')
 local hp=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current;if not initial then initial=hp end
 local item=types.Actor.getEquipment(self,types.Actor.EQUIPMENT_SLOT.CarriedRight)
 print('BladeUse sample player='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' target='..hp..' blade='..types.NPC.stats.skills.longblade(self).base..' xp='..types.NPC.stats.skills.longblade(self).progress..' weapon='..(item and item.recordId or 'none'))
 if item and item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1c6cd) and types.Actor.getStance(self)==types.Actor.STANCE.Weapon then print('BladeUse readied') end
 if hp<initial-.01 then print('BladeUse original enemy hurt') end
 local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target:getBoundingBox().center);local delta=target.position-self.position;local forward=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local yaw=math.atan2(forward.y*delta.x-forward.x*delta.y,forward.x*delta.x+forward.y*delta.y);local pitch=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 print(string.format('BladeUse aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.02 and math.abs(pitch)<.02 then print('BladeUse facing') end
end}}}}
